name: Hakone Miriya
source:
"I want to become a bona fide pilot and help the Red Zone as soon as I can..."

A top-scoring STX Space Force pilot, or Silver Star. With dreams of becoming a Battle-SHEEP combat pilot, she feels let down by her own innate lack of sel skills.

Average but earnest, she relies on hard work alone.
Pure at heart, but largely naive about the world.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2051100]Steam[/url]]
